title: Implement partial compaction
objective: Add TypeScript-equivalent partial compaction for selected ranges and directions while preserving prompt-cache and resume semantics.
implementation_scope: Add partial compact prompts for from and up_to directions.
Implement PartialCompactConversation(allMessages, pivotIndex, direction, userFeedback) returning CompactionResult.
For from direction, keep earlier messages and summarize newer range.
For up_to direction, summarize earlier prefix and keep later messages.
Annotate compact boundary with preserved segment metadata.
Preserve API invariants at the boundary and in messagesToKeep.
Thread user feedback/custom instructions into the prompt.
out_of_scope: Do not build interactive UI for choosing pivot unless an existing command surface already supports it.
Do not implement session-memory compaction in this task.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover from and up_to directions, empty/invalid pivot, preserved segment metadata, and prompt content.
Partial compact never splits tool pairs or assistant fragments.
Result ordering follows BuildPostCompactMessages and preserves the intended segment verbatim.
risks: Partial compaction has subtle cache implications; document direction-specific cache behavior.
Resume chain repair depends on task_01 boundary metadata.
dispatch_prompt: Implement TS-like partial compaction in Go with from/up_to directions, partial prompts, preserved segment metadata, and invariant-safe message slicing.
